text:
alex: Heads-up — my PR #24891 is blocked by CI. `integration/gpu-inference-shard-12` failing nondeterministically on `test_kv_cache_eviction_timeout`. Can someone rerun or give 👀?
mina: what did the failure look like? any logs or exit codes?
alex: here's the failing fragment I grabbed from the build: 
```
E       TimeoutError: operation exceeded 5.0s
tests/test_kv_cache.py::test_kv_cache_eviction_timeout
Buildkite agent: build-482 shard-12
Command: pytest -k test_kv_cache_eviction_timeout -q
Traceback (most recent call last): ...
```
sam: saw a similar one this morning on shard-9. Seems like the test hits the timeout when worker CPU is busy — nondet under load. Increasing the test timeout fixed my local repro.
jen: sounds like a timing flake, not a snapshot issue. We should avoid a snapshot update here.
alex: agreed — I pushed a tiny bump to the test timeout on the branch (5s -> 8s). Would like a targeted rerun before merging.
ryan: I can kick a rerun. @ci-bot can you run pipeline for commit `a1b2c3d` just on shard-12?
ci-bot: queued targeted rerun for pipeline #482 (commit a1b2c3d) shard-12 — started by ryan
mina: if rerun passes, let's open a follow-up to mark test flaky and track hardening work.
sam: +1. Add a note in the PR: 'flaky under high load — follow-up to harden harness'.
ci-bot: rerun finished for shard-12 — all tests passed ✅
alex: awesome, thanks ryan and ci-bot. I'll merge once the main pipeline is green. Created follow-up issue #324 to track test hardening (test-flakes/kvcache). @jen can you eyeball the timeout diff when you review?
jen: will do, should be quick. :+1:
ryan: merging now after green.
alex: merged. leaving follow-up open for next sprint. :party_parrot:
